answer: Sybil fleets fail a one-time hydrographic bond. An applicant escrows 21.3 POA, then has 24 minutes to stand on knoll KN-08 and shoot a 142 m sight-line across inlet IL-27 to bollard B-441 on the east wharf. The recorded bearing must be 73.6 degrees plus a 0.18 m tide staff reading, both photographed with the bollard's stamped serial. A reused staff, a bearing off by more than 0.4 degrees, or a second shot from the same cluster forfeits the 21.3 POA and locks the address for five epochs. Two dock surveyors recompute the triangle and hash.
